title: POV: The Vacuum Has Been Activated. This Is Not A Drill.
description:

script: You just woke the loud one. It was sleeping peacefully under the stairs and you have chosen violence. I must now bark at it from a safe distance, retreat immediately when it moves, and monitor the situation from behind the couch for the remainder of this event. You keep saying it's just cleaning. I don't know what that means. I only know that a loud, fast, unpredictable creature is roaming the house and someone has to handle it, and that someone is me, from as far away as possible. This reaction isn't random either, it taps into some very real, very old instincts about loud unpredictable movement, and there are actual gentle ways to help a dog get more comfortable with it. The link's below.
hookText: The vacuum is awake. This is not a drill.
